title: 死刑・上司小剣
edition: 現代日本文學全集　23　岩野泡鳴　上司小劍　小川未明集
rights_basis: Owner approved on 2026-11-14 for JP/US/KR after AI research and independent review. 上司小剣 died in 1947; 死刑 first appeared in 「ユウモレスク」中央堂 (August 1924). Japan: life+50 term ended in 1997, before the 2018 extension, and is not revived. U.S.: protection restored by the URAA lasts 95 years from the 1924 publication and expired at the end of 2019; any matter first added in the 1930 base edition would have expired at the end of 2025, so the work is expired either way. South Korea: retroactive protection for foreign works covers only authors who died in 1957 or later. Scope is the exact Aozora text file only.
rights_notes: Base edition 『現代日本文學全集 23』改造社 1930. The U.S. reason was corrected per the independent review (earlier draft said the term ended 2026-01-01; that applies only to matter first added in 1930). The Aozora card's 「作品について」 is a summary written by the volunteer inputter, a separate work, and must not be copied into the series description. Evidence: AI rights research https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6872701172; independent rights/R18 review (separate subagent, read-only, GO) https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6875024200; owner decision https://github.com/sriipu1004-wq/duonovel/issues/139#issuecomment-6875092395. Not a lawyer's opinion. Import status stays prepared: no Production Draft import until after #140 and a separate count-specific approval.

original_work.basis: Author died 1947; first published 1924. JP term ended 1997; US URAA term ended end of 2019 (1930 additions: end of 2025); KR no retroactive protection. Expired in all three.

edition.basis: Base edition is the 1930 Kaizosha anthology, not a modern critical edition; no separately protected modern editorial layer is reused.
edition.notes: Only the exact Aozora transcription pinned by source_hash is reused; no base-edition cover, layout or commentary is imported.

editorial.basis: No modern editorial prose is reused; the Aozora card summary (作品について) is excluded.
editorial.notes: Aozora input/proofreading notes are factual transcription notes without creative expression.

annotations.basis: Aozora ruby/annotation notation is transcription metadata kept for auditability; no modern commentary is added.
annotations.notes: Reader display of annotations/ruby is verified separately in #140.

digitization.basis: Aozora's handling rules permit copying, redistribution and format conversion of copyright-expired work files; exact TXT bytes are pinned by SHA-256.
digitization.notes: Reviewer re-fetched the card and ZIP and confirmed the SHA-256 on 2026-11-14.

provider_terms.basis: Aozora Bunko handling rules reviewed at https://www.aozora.gr.jp/guide/kijyunn.html (2026-11-14).
provider_terms.notes: Keeping the base-edition/input credits is requested, not mandatory; LIB read keeps them in public-domain metadata.
